title: The Stone's Holding Dark

features.name: the pressure that remembers
features.desc-on-touch: Stone that holds the shape of everything that has passed through it. Weight is its only language, and it has much to say about what it has borne.

features.name: the fossil grammar
features.desc-on-touch: You read shells and bone arranged by stone, speaking a language of compression. Each layer is a sentence the stone has held for ages without translation.

features.name: where time stops being direction
features.desc-on-touch: In the stone, past and future are the same pressure. You are reading what you will have carried here, and the stone knew before you arrived.

features.name: the archive before archiving
features.desc-on-touch: This stone predates all the casing nodes, all the mesh, all the broadcasts. It is the dark that learns without choosing to, older than intention.

inscription: stone holds not because it chooses, but because choosing is what soft things do
